name: Minimalist Tiki
description: Matt Pietrek's rum styles by flavor profile rather than production: the six Golden Era styles from Minimalist Tiki (2019) plus the two unaged styles from his nine-essential-styles update — unaged cane juice (agricole, cachaça, clairin) and unaged Jamaican overproof.

nodes.name: Aged Demerara rum
nodes.description: Rich, molasses-dark aged rum in the Guyana Demerara style that anchors classics like the Planter's Punch and Queen's Park Swizzle.

nodes.name: Aged Jamaican rum
nodes.description: Funky, ester-forward aged rum in the Golden Era Jamaican style — the Mai Tai and Zombie backbone. Named for Jamaica because 'funky' and 'hogo' rarely appear on labels.

nodes.name: Aged cane juice rum
nodes.description: Aged cane-juice rum: rhum agricole vieux and aged cachaça, the grassy-then-oaky cane-juice style. Pietrek's caveat: Golden Era 'Martinique rum' was molasses rum, so the style is a modern reading.

nodes.name: Lightly aged/filtered rum
nodes.description: A white or lightly colored mixing rum aged briefly then filtered to clarity — the workhorse of Golden Era swizzles and punches.

nodes.name: Moderately aged rum
nodes.description: A mid-aged gold rum in the Spanish-heritage style — rounded, low funk, the everyday aged mixing rum.

nodes.name: Overproof Demerara rum
nodes.description: High-proof Demerara rum — Lemon Hart 151 and its kin, the float-and-flame rum of the Zombie family.

nodes.name: Unaged Jamaican overproof rum
nodes.description: High-ester, unaged Jamaican overproof — Wray & Nephew and its kin: as subtle as an air-raid siren, used in half-ounce dashes.

nodes.name: Unaged cane juice rum
nodes.description: Unaged cane-juice rum — blanc rhum agricole, unaged cachaça, Haitian clairin: grassy and vegetal, the Ti Punch pour. Pietrek's article lists cachaça and blanc agricoles together in this style.
